description: If the top drawer starts closed, it must end open; if it starts open, it must end closed.
note: This instantiation's :init fixes the drawer to start open (BDDL has no per-episode randomized joint state, only randomized object placement), so the branch is deterministic here -- but the conditional_branch check below still exercises the general 'act on the actual starting state, don't assume' mechanism, and would generalize correctly if a future variant randomizes the start state.
